message.content:
A medium tomato (about 123 g) contains roughly **22 calories**.  
- Small tomato (~80 g): ~15 cal  
- Large tomato (~182 g): ~25 cal  

So you can expect a tomato to be a very low‑calorie food, with most of its energy coming from carbohydrates (mostly sugars and fiber).
